svg.title: Illustrative offline scaling hypothesis — not measured

cc:Work.dc:title: Illustrative offline scaling hypothesis — not measured
cc:Work.dc:description: All three accuracy values are hypothetical estimates, including the 1x point. Dataset sizes are 8230, 16460 and 32920 accepted responses. This is not evidence of diversity or absence of collapse.
